newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Anscor abandons cement joint venture plan.
newsitem.headline: Anscor abandons cement joint venture plan.

text.p: A Soriano Corp (Anscor) said on Monday it had abandoned a cement joint venture project with Global Equities Inc and some Japanese firms.
Anscor told the Philippine Stock Exchange the project, which is in the pre-development stage, is no longer feasible due to changes in market conditions.
In a separate statement, Global Equities Inc confirmed they had agreed to drop their cement project.
Both the statements did not name the Japanese firms that were meant to be part of the joint venture.
